The classic Bvlgari chain strap can be worn as a necklace-like decoration or as an exquisite handle, showcasing the essence of the jewelry brand's design. title:
Original hardware and leather, easily pass customs and counters. Sweet or cool style~  
Goyard mini Saigon bag. Since our last launch of the Goyard mini tote, many have requested this Saigon bag. The wooden handle is uniquely attractive.  
This highly sought-after mini Saigon bag symbolizes love, elegance, and refinement. Low-key with perfect craftsmanship, it’s a charming vintage style that’s hard to resist.  
The wooden handle is a stylish highlight, adding romantic elegance. The shoulder strap is fully detachable, allowing it to be carried by the small wooden ring—super chic!  
Like the authentic, the wood grain on the ring is clear and smooth, treated with imported waterproof lacquer to prevent yellowing or moisture damage over time.  
The Saigon bag uses its printed logo sparingly, only under the flap. Leather covers the edges for durability and a refined finish.  
Size: 20*16*6 cm. Large capacity, versatile for all seasons.

Goyard mini Saigon bag. Since our last launch of the Goyard mini tote, many have requested this Saigon bag. The wooden handle is uniquely attractive.

The Saigon bag uses its printed logo sparingly, only under the flap. Leather covers the edges for durability and refined workmanship.  
Size: 20*16*6 cm. Large capacity, versatile for all seasons.

title: Limited edition collaboration design by BVLG** featuring the iconic print queen designer Mary Katrantzou's snake head bag 🐍 is simply stunning. Redefining the snake head bag with a new interpretation, it is crafted with soft matte crocodile embossed lambskin paired with light gold-plated brass accents. The light gold-plated brass reinterprets the classic SERPENTI snake head clasp, adorned with captivating crystal eyes, showcasing elements from BVLGARI's antique watches. title:
Black! Original hardware and leather, easily passes customs and boutiques. Sweet or cool style~  
Goyard mini Saigon bag. Since our last launch of the Goyard mini tote, many have requested this Saigon bag. The wooden handle is uniquely attractive.  
This highly sought-after mini Saigon bag symbolizes love, elegance, and refinement. Low-key with perfect craftsmanship. Elegant, vintage, and charming—hard to resist.  
The wooden handle is a stylish highlight, adding romance and elegance. The shoulder strap is fully detachable; carry by the small wooden ring for an ultra-chic look.  
Like the authentic, the wood grain on the ring is clear and smooth, treated with imported waterproof lacquer to prevent yellowing or moisture damage over time.  
Saigon uses its signature print sparingly, only under the flap. Leather covers the edges for durability and refined workmanship.  
Size: 20*16*6cm. Large capacity, versatile for all seasons.

title:
Green! Original hardware and leather, easily passes customs and counters, exclusively for high-end customers. Can be sweet or cool~  
Goyard mini Saigon bag. Since our last launch of the Goyard mini tote, many have been asking for this Saigon bag. The wooden handle design is truly eye-catching.  
This time, we present the highly sought-after mini Saigon bag—rated five stars for rarity! Symbolizing love, elegance, and refinement, the Saigon bag is understated yet perfectly crafted.  
Elegant and vintage with charm, it’s hard to resist. The wooden handle is a stylish highlight, adding romance and grace. The shoulder strap is fully detachable, allowing you to carry the small wooden ring handle for a chic look.  
Like the authentic, the wood grain on the ring is clear and smooth, treated with imported waterproof lacquer to prevent yellowing or moisture damage over time.  
The Saigon bag uses its printed logo sparingly, only under the flap. Leather covers the edges and corners for durability and refined craftsmanship.  
Colors: Green, Black, Gray, Brown  
Size: 20 x 16 x 6 cm  
Large capacity, versatile for all seasons.

title: Limited edition collaboration design by BVLG** featuring the iconic print queen designer Mary Katrantzou's snake head bag 🐍 is simply stunning. Redefining the snake head bag with a new interpretation, it is crafted with soft matte crocodile embossed lambskin paired with light gold-plated brass accents. The light gold-plated brass reinterprets the classic SERPENTI snake head clasp, adorned with captivating crystal eyes, showcasing elements from BVLGARI's antique watches. #GoyardCitadin#

One size only: 38cm (L) x 26cm (H) x 8cm (W)  
Available in five colors: black, brown, navy, green, and gray.  
🔎020182

title:
💝Brand new Goyard Citadin Messenger Bag  
#GoyardCitadin#  
Named after the French word for "urbanite," this bag features a detachable shoulder strap. It can be used as a briefcase for business or worn crossbody for casual elegance, combining functionality with versatility.  
Made from premium BOX smooth leather and Goyardine cotton-linen canvas, it exudes luxury.  
The new Goyard Citadin Messenger Bag is now available at Goyard boutiques in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Chengdu, and Hong Kong.  
One size only: 38cm (L) x 26cm (H) x 8cm (W)  
Available in five colors: black, brown, navy, green, and gray.

💝Brand new Goyard Citadin Messenger Bag  
#GoyardCitadin#

Made from premium BOX smooth leather and Goyardine cotton-linen canvas, it exudes luxury.  
The new Goyard Citadin Messenger Bag is now available at Goyard boutiques in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Chengdu, and Hong Kong.  
One size only: 38cm (L) x 26cm (H) x 8cm (W)  
Available in five colors: black, brown, navy, green, and gray.  
🔎020182

title:
💝Brand new Goyard Citadin Messenger Bag  
#GoyardCitadin#  
Named after the French word for "urbanite," this bag features a detachable shoulder strap. It can be used as a briefcase for business or worn crossbody for casual elegance, combining functionality with versatility.  
Made from premium BOX smooth leather and Goyardine cotton-linen canvas, it exudes luxury.  
The new Goyard Citadin Messenger Bag is now available at Goyard boutiques in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Chengdu, and Hong Kong.  
One size only: 38cm (L) x 26cm (H) x 8cm (W)  
Available in five colors: black, brown, navy, green, and gray.  
🔎020182
